user.title: Find your Opal
user.description: Choose an Opal detected by Home Assistant Bluetooth or its active proxies. Use Scan again to refresh the list.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Connect discovered Opal
bluetooth_confirm.description: Choose a connectable adapter or an active ESPHome Bluetooth proxy in range. Keep pairing enabled for first-generation Opal.

data.pair: Pair after connecting (recommended for first-generation Opal)

manual.title: Enter a Bluetooth address
manual.description: Use this if your device is not listed. A connectable adapter or proxy must still be in range.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read Opal status. Check Bluetooth range, active connection support, other connected apps, and pairing requirements. See HA logs for details.
error.invalid_address: Enter a MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.scan_failed: The Bluetooth scan could not complete. Choose a previously detected device or try scanning again.
error.device_not_found: That device is no longer in the detected list. Scan again or enter its address manually.
